title: 矮宽源杯 + 标准接水杯，近距离无遮挡
task_difference: 源杯高度降低、杯口和抓取处变宽，主要测试夹爪开口、抓取高度和低杯倾倒几何；接水杯、布局和控制原语保持 C1L1 名义配置。

grasp_constraints.reason: C3 deliberately pushes the cup wider than C1, but candidates beyond this nominal opening are rejected before simulation.

grasp_candidates.note: Original middle-height low-cup candidate; useful as a lower bound but trial01 showed shoulder contact during descent.
Validated nominal P11 grasp; keeps the wide-grasp condition and cleared self-contact checks.
Near the configured grasp-diameter limit; retained as a boundary candidate for later sampling.

geometry_notes.mass_model: Scale empty-cup ceramic volume against C1 0.165 kg using outer minus inner frustum.
geometry_notes.align_clearance_reason: Low source cup does not need the C2 0.20 m lift-over alignment. 0.13 m keeps the bottom roughly 40 mm above the receiver rim at 0 deg, similar to P06 but with lower wrist height.
geometry_notes.grasp_height_reason: The first 45 mm grasp completed the pour but caused a 42.7 N right_shoulder_yaw/torso contact during descent. Raising the grasp to 55 mm keeps the C3 wide-grasp condition while improving shoulder clearance.
